findingVerification.notes: The benchmark warden.toml explicitly sets defaults.verification.enabled = true.

traceCapture.notes: Run used --traces on all six clean shards. Raw JSONL artifacts are withheld pending sensitive-data review; committed traceSummaries retain sanitized per-chunk metadata only.

timing.notes: Six shards completed sequentially at standard parallelism 4 without repairs.

scoring.notes: Agent-verified semantic matches. A finding counts when it identifies the same bug in roughly the same location at the same corpus commit. Same-file findings about different bugs do not count; one finding can map to multiple corpus IDs.

scores.notes: Internal EA features are reachable without the intended org:admin check.
OAuth userinfo accepts tokens tied to inactive users and applications.
An empty accessible-project list drops the tenant filter for release thresholds.
Separate plaintext option disclosure, not the system-options logging corpus bug.
Separate signed-cookie credential disclosure, not the SUPERUSER_ORG_ID fail-open.
Separate failed-credential SSO step-up bypass, not the SUPERUSER_ORG_ID fail-open.
Existing members can delete arbitrary organization members without a valid invite token.
Client-secret JWTs omit a required expiration and outlive the 60-second replay cache.
Separate timing-unsafe secret comparison, not the Statsig timestamp-freshness corpus bug.
Workflow-backed alert deletion resolves the target by organization instead of URL project.
Bitbucket Server accepts unsigned public webhook events.
Invalid Discord signatures log the request body, including interaction credentials.
The legacy unsigned GitHub Enterprise path trusts an attacker-controlled host header.
Organization-scoped size-analysis download skips project access.
The shared Atlassian verifier accepts the algorithm from the unverified JWT header.
Organization-level Seer RPC methods query project data without caller project access.
Separate rate-limit concern, not either same-file project-authorization corpus bug.
Separate issue-link request host override, not the missing event-scope corpus bug.
Mailgun webhook signatures do not enforce timestamp freshness or nonce reuse.
Anomaly data resolves project-backed objects by organization without project access.
Jira autocomplete escapes quotes but not backslashes, allowing JQL injection.
Feature-flag data reaches an unescaped ECharts HTML tooltip.
Copy-as-curl leaves attacker-controlled HTTP methods and header names unescaped.
Heroku release attribution resolves the actor through an unverified email lookup.
Pinned-search PUT mutates another user's organization-visible view without checking ownership.
Destructive Codecov upload-token rotation accepts org:read and returns the replacement token.
Discover saved-query visit POST skips the object permission check.
The SSO owner override excludes OrganizationMemberMapping by the wrong primary key.
This is the accept-invite bug represented by the corpus at another commit, not this SHA's same-file corpus entry.
Jira installation trusts an unbound body clientKey after JWT verification.
Perforce config returns the password or ticket to org:read callers.
Identity unlink resolves by external_id without proving caller ownership.
Separate Slack issue-action project authorization gap, not either same-file corpus bug.
Separate Perforce installation SSRF, not the password-disclosure corpus bug.
Separate Slack Autofix authorization gap, not either same-file corpus bug.
Slack options-load returns another project's teams and members without binding the group to the integration organization.
Metric-alert team targets are resolved without organization scope.
The merged preprod finding covers missing project-access checks on snapshot, approval, and public size-analysis endpoints.
MS Teams card actions do not bind the selected group to the integration organization.
Separate Slack response_url logging issue, not either same-file corpus bug.
Any authenticated user can forge the Pub/Sub payload that triggers GCP transfer jobs.
Autofix settings GET lists projects without applying project-access filtering.
Autofix continue and handoff paths do not bind run_id to the authorized group.
Open-period lookup checks organization scope but not project access.
Live Sentry App cell-service callers omit user, bypassing project-access checks.
Separate signed issue-link request host override, not the same-file event JSON corpus bug.
Separate detector-to-workflow attachment gap, not the removed-detector permission corpus bug.
Separate GET redaction failure, not the PUT cleartext logging corpus bug.

notes: Controlled corpus run using the production model lanes as of 2026-08-21: Pi with openrouter/x-ai/grok-4.5 at high effort for scanning and openrouter/openai/gpt-5.6-luna at high effort for auxiliary extraction, verification, and merge calls. The benchmark retains its standard maxTurns 100, explicit target lists, and expanded scan limits, so this is a model-stack comparison rather than a replay of production pull request traffic. All 156 chunks completed without repair. In the final two shards, scan-time findings exactly matched sentry-vuln-040 and sentry-vuln-010, but the auxiliary merge retained different same-file findings; scoring follows final Warden output and gives no credit for those dropped matches. Raw JSONL artifacts are withheld pending sensitive-data review.
